title: IEANTN (Terence Tao): Kernel-Checked Chebyshev ψ(n) ≤ 1.11 n Bound
description: Verbatim open challenge from Terence Tao's Integrated Explicit Analytic Number Theory Network (teorth/IEANTN@cd9c2dd3, Apache-2.0). Proves `∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) ≤ 11723 → Chebyshev.psi n ≤ 1.11 * n` purely inside the Lean 4 kernel (0 sorry, standard axioms only — no `native_decide` / `Lean.ofReduceBool`), upgrading `Chebyshev.v1.psi_upper_clean` (`ψ(x) ≤ 1.11 x` for all `x > 0`) from an unchecked numerical assertion to a Comparator-verified Lean proof.

tasks.title: Kernel-check Chebyshev ψ(n) ≤ 1.11 n for all n ≤ 11723 (no native_decide)
tasks.description: Prove `ChebyshevNumerics.v1.challenge_psi_le_below_11723 : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) ≤ 11723 → Chebyshev.psi n ≤ 1.11 * n` inside the Lean 4 kernel with 0 sorry and standard axioms only (`propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` — `native_decide` / `Lean.ofReduceBool` is rejected). A rational-interval or certificate-based proof checked inside the kernel discharges the sole remaining unverified finite base case behind `Chebyshev.v1.psi_upper_clean` in `teorth/IEANTN`.
